title: Bound on the number of answer vectors
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer and let $p$ be a deterministic one-way protocol for indexing on $n$-bit inputs. The number of distinct answer vectors of $p$ is at most $2^{c}$, where $c=\lceil\log_2 |\mathrm{Message}(p)|\rceil$ is its communication cost.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a deterministic one-way protocol with a finite, nonempty message codebook
replaced:
A one-way protocol $p$ of cost $c$ realises at most $2^c$ distinct answer vectors:
$\abs{A} \le 2^{p.\mathrm{cost}}$.
